comments.author: JeanLuucGodard
comments.body:
Bruh, remove that weird ass moan sound from it. It's irritating. 

Apart from that, the game is really nice

replies.author: WeDevelopGames
replies.body: Thank you for your suggestion, I got really few comments or suggestion on this game and it means a lot. I will try to fix that and thank you for liking the game.

replies.author: WeDevelopGames
replies.body: The Game is already out! Link in this post description

comments.author: Western-Hotel8723
comments.body:
Game looks good. Fun.

Trailer presentation needs a lot of work. 

Not a good voice for the voice over of the game. 

Also the title text at the end looks like standard GPT yellow text output. If you're going to use AI give it examples of other game titles so that it doesn't give you a generic result.
